newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end down on blue chip profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end down on blue chip profit-taking.

text.p: The Manila share index closed slightly down on Tuesday on profit-taking in blue chips while most local investors bought thirdliners, traders said.

"Its a steady, consolidating market. A lot of the second and thirdliners are the ones that are interesting but there's no real push from blue chips," said Irving Ackerman, president at I.Ackerman & Co.
The main index closed 1.62 points down at 3,279.23 points.
